public_rationale: This forecast applies only if OpenAI fails to keep up its rapid rise. In the available evidence that has not happened. limitations: No evidence on OpenAI's valuation between April and October 2026.

Outcome: pension funds with OpenAI exposure, such as CalPERS, report or are reported to take sizable losses on that exposure.
'Stand to' is a hedge on exposure, so the claim only becomes testable if the antecedent happens.
